extra_quotes: We utilize the AnalogGenie dataset as our benchmark, which includes components such as resistors, capacitors, inductors, and transistors, along with graphical and netlist representations of circuits.

We compare our model with several state-of-the-art analog circuit generation methods, including CktGNN [14] (V AE-based graph generation), LaMAGIC [9] (masked graph model), AnalogCoder [17] (code-generation approach), and AnalogGenie (autoregressive graph modeling).
